# Hush, Little One  

This morning, I wished so deeply to be a child once more,  
To be tightly wrapped in a cozy blanket,  
Carried against a gentle body, humming soft and free,  
Where all was right and good and safe —  
At least that everything I knew,  
Which was, in truth, but nothing and still likely remains.  
  
So I wandered on,  
Aimless, caught in daydream’s haze,  
Or perhaps in regret, but either way —  
As I stumbled down the dune, gazing at the sea and mountains all around,  
I realized I was wrapped in nature's blanket:  

Hush, hush, little one,  
Hush, hush, darling,  
Daddy will come tomorrow to take you away,  
And bring for you a meal of sweet porridge today.
